item.title: Apache ManifoldCF 2.31 Released: The Java 25 Leap, Virtual Threads, and Next-Gen Core Modernization
item.description: Official release of Apache ManifoldCF 2.31 under CONNECTORS-1784: Java 25 runtime baseline, Project Loom Virtual Threads across the crawling engine, Jetty 12.1 modernization, 88,000+ lines of legacy code removed, and automated Docker CI/CD integration testing.
item.author: Piergiorgio Lucidi

item.title: Welcome to the Apache ManifoldCF Blog: Connecting Enterprise Content to Search Engines
item.description: Explore how Apache ManifoldCF bridges diverse enterprise content repositories—SharePoint, Confluence, CMIS, Amazon S3, HDFS, and Google Drive—with target search engines like Apache Solr, Elasticsearch, and OpenSearch while enforcing fine-grained security ACLs.
item.author: Apache ManifoldCF Project Team
